entry.zh: 不要求编程基础；会使用电脑和文件夹即可。
entry.en: No coding experience required; comfortable using a computer and folders.

outcome.zh: 一个能添加、搜索和保存内容的小应用。
outcome.en: A small app that adds, searches, and saves information.

milestones.zh: 选一个用途：社团活动、阅读清单或职位看板
milestones.en: Choose a purpose: club events, reading lists, or a job board

milestones.zh: 借助 AI 做页面，理解输入与输出
milestones.en: Use AI to build a page and trace inputs and outputs

milestones.zh: 把页面和服务连接起来
milestones.en: Connect the page to a server

milestones.zh: 保存数据，检查刷新和重启
milestones.en: Save data and check reloads and restarts

milestones.zh: 找到并修复一个错误
milestones.en: Find and fix a bug

milestones.zh: 请别人试用，修改并演示
milestones.en: Ask someone to try it, improve it, and demonstrate

assessment.zh: 刷新后数据仍在，搜索真的会筛选
assessment.en: Data survives a reload and search actually filters

assessment.zh: 解释一次请求经过哪里，并独立修改一个功能
assessment.en: Trace a request and independently change a feature

extension.zh: 在自己的兴趣题材上换内容、改规则。
extension.en: Change the content and rules to match your interests.

title.zh: 做一个别人能用的产品

entry.zh: 能运行和修改小应用，理解页面、服务和数据的关系。
entry.en: Can run and modify a small app and explain page, server, and data flow.

outcome.zh: 一个有账号、权限、完整操作流程和 AI 功能的网站。
outcome.en: A website with accounts, permissions, a complete user workflow, and an AI feature.

milestones.zh: 画出两类用户和一次完整操作
milestones.en: Define two user roles and a complete workflow

milestones.zh: 实现登录、数据结构和权限
milestones.en: Implement sign-in, data structures, and permissions

milestones.zh: 完成发布与申请，或下单与处理
milestones.en: Complete posting and applying, or ordering and fulfilment

milestones.zh: 接入 AI 摘要或分类，保留人工确认
milestones.en: Add AI summaries or classification with human review

milestones.zh: 测试越权、重复提交和 AI 错误
milestones.en: Test unauthorized actions, duplicate submissions, and AI mistakes

milestones.zh: 部署试用，记录反馈并修订
milestones.en: Deploy for testing, collect feedback, and revise

assessment.zh: 另一个人独立完成一次业务流程
assessment.en: Another person completes the workflow without help

assessment.zh: 用户不能改别人的数据；失败有提示且能恢复
assessment.en: Users cannot alter others’ data; failures are visible and recoverable

extension.zh: 招聘网站、社团平台、小店接单或知识助手。
extension.en: Job boards, club platforms, shop orders, or knowledge assistants.

title.zh: 让 AI 完成一段工作
title.en: An AI system that handles a workflow

entry.zh: 能完成有账号和数据库的产品，并会调试 API。
entry.en: Can build an authenticated database-backed product and debug APIs.

outcome.zh: 一个会调用工具、处理文件、保留任务记录的 AI 工作助手。
outcome.en: An AI work assistant that uses tools, handles files, and records its work.

milestones.zh: 选定工作流程，建立成功与失败样例
milestones.en: Define the workflow and success and failure examples

milestones.zh: 设计可调用的工具和权限范围
milestones.en: Define tools and their permission boundaries

milestones.zh: 管理文件、上下文和任务状态
milestones.en: Manage files, context, and task state

milestones.zh: 加入确认、预算和取消机制
milestones.en: Add approval, budget, and cancellation controls

milestones.zh: 测试错误输入、工具失败和恶意指令
milestones.en: Test bad input, tool failures, and hostile instructions

milestones.zh: 比较版本表现，记录成本并交付
milestones.en: Compare versions, record costs, and deliver

assessment.zh: 在未见过的任务上评估成功率和成本
assessment.en: Evaluate success rate and cost on unseen tasks

assessment.zh: 未经确认不发送邮件或改重要文件；失败可追踪
assessment.en: No email sends or important file changes without approval; failures are traceable

extension.zh: 邮件处理、资料整理、社团运营；AI Agent 是实现这些功能的工具。
extension.en: Inbox work, document organization, or club operations, using AI agents where useful.

title.zh: 传感器 · 自动化 · 机器人

title.en: Sense the room and control a light

entry.zh: 不要求硬件经验；可以先在模拟环境开始。
entry.en: No hardware experience required; begin in simulation.

outcome.zh: 一个温湿度面板和按规则亮灭的指示灯。
outcome.en: A temperature and humidity dashboard with a rule-controlled light.

milestones.zh: 认清传感器、控制板和输出设备
milestones.en: Identify the sensor, controller, and output

milestones.zh: 读取并理解温湿度数值
milestones.en: Read and interpret temperature and humidity

milestones.zh: 连接网页，记录带时间的读数
milestones.en: Connect a dashboard and timestamp readings

milestones.zh: 实现阈值与停止命令
milestones.en: Implement thresholds and a stop command

milestones.zh: 检查失效、断线和旧数据
milestones.en: Check sensor failure, disconnection, and stale data

milestones.zh: 导出实验记录并解释结果
milestones.en: Export experiment records and explain results

assessment.zh: 正常、停止、失效三种情况都有记录
assessment.en: Record normal, stopped, and failed states

assessment.zh: 分清模拟读数与实物读数，解释两种阈值
assessment.en: Distinguish simulated and physical readings and explain two thresholds

extension.zh: 桌面环境站、植物状态提醒、房间温度记录。
extension.en: Desk monitors, plant status reminders, or room temperature logs.

entry.zh: 能读取传感器、使用面板并处理停止与失效。
entry.en: Can read sensors, use a dashboard, and handle stop and failure states.

outcome.zh: 一个由传感器驱动、有限位与停止控制的舵机装置。
outcome.en: A sensor-driven servo mechanism with motion limits and stop controls.

milestones.zh: 选定用途，画结构和接线
milestones.en: Choose a use and draw the structure and wiring

milestones.zh: 确认供电、负载和动作范围
milestones.en: Check power, load, and motion range

milestones.zh: 校准传感器与舵机位置
milestones.en: Calibrate sensor readings and servo positions

milestones.zh: 加入手动与自动模式
milestones.en: Add manual and automatic modes

milestones.zh: 测试断线、抖动与停止后的行为
milestones.en: Test disconnects, jitter, and behavior after stopping

milestones.zh: 重复实验，比较稳定性
milestones.en: Repeat experiments and compare reliability

assessment.zh: 动作不超过约定范围，模式切换可解释
assessment.en: Motion stays within agreed limits and mode changes are explainable

assessment.zh: 在三种不同输入条件下重复成功
assessment.en: Repeat successful behavior under three input conditions

extension.zh: 转向底座、互动装置、模型温室；先确认具体设备。
extension.en: A rotating platform, interactive mechanism, or model greenhouse; agree on hardware first.

title.zh: 做一台会调整动作的小机器人
title.en: Build a robot that adjusts its actions

entry.zh: 能独立完成传感器与执行器项目，具备基本调试经验。
entry.en: Can complete a sensor-actuator project and troubleshoot it.

outcome.zh: 一台能感知距离、调整路线并记录表现的小车。
outcome.en: A rover that senses distance, adjusts its route, and records performance.

milestones.zh: 定义场地、任务和通过标准
milestones.en: Define the course, task, and success criteria

milestones.zh: 组装底盘并测试电机与停止方式
milestones.en: Assemble the chassis and test motors and stopping

milestones.zh: 测量距离，校准速度与转向
milestones.en: Measure distance and calibrate speed and steering

milestones.zh: 实现感知与动作反馈
milestones.en: Implement sensing and action feedback

milestones.zh: 比较不同路线和干扰条件
milestones.en: Compare routes and disturbance conditions

milestones.zh: 用实验记录改进设计
milestones.en: Improve the design using experiment records

assessment.zh: 多次完成约定路线，报告失败次数和原因
assessment.en: Complete repeated runs and report failures and causes

assessment.zh: 能根据新障碍修改策略；明确感知与机械限制
assessment.en: Adapt to a new obstacle and explain sensing and mechanical limits

extension.zh: 避障、循线或遥控协作；视觉识别作为后续扩展。
extension.en: Obstacle avoidance, line following, or remote cooperation; vision is a later extension.

entry.zh: 不要求投资或钱包经验；只使用练习网络。
entry.en: No investing or wallet experience required; use practice networks only.

outcome.zh: 一个能显示地址、余额、交易和确认状态的查询工具。
outcome.en: A viewer for addresses, balances, transactions, and confirmation status.

milestones.zh: 区分钱包、账户、网络和资产
milestones.en: Distinguish wallets, accounts, networks, and assets

milestones.zh: 使用练习账户发起一笔交易
milestones.en: Send a transaction from a practice account

milestones.zh: 读取交易与确认状态
milestones.en: Read transactions and confirmation status

milestones.zh: 用整数单位计算金额与费用
milestones.en: Calculate amounts and fees in integer units

milestones.zh: 比较错误地址、失败与等待状态
milestones.en: Compare wrong addresses, failures, and pending states

milestones.zh: 做成可查询的页面并解释证据
milestones.en: Build a query page and explain the evidence

assessment.zh: 能解释网络、金额、手续费和确认的区别
assessment.en: Explain network, amount, fee, and confirmation

assessment.zh: 不会把等待或失败的交易当作成功
assessment.en: Do not treat pending or failed transactions as successful

extension.zh: 以太坊测试网查询；比特币输入、找零和手续费可单独深入。
extension.en: Ethereum testnet queries; Bitcoin inputs, change, and fees are an optional deeper route.

title.zh: 用 NFT 管理会员权限

entry.zh: 能做基础网页，理解账户和交易；可先补软件基础。
entry.en: Can build a basic page and explain accounts and transactions; bridge software gaps first.

outcome.zh: 一个用钱包签名登录、按 NFT 持有情况开放内容的网站。
outcome.en: A site with wallet sign-in and content access based on NFT ownership.

milestones.zh: 定义会员能访问什么
milestones.en: Define what membership unlocks

milestones.zh: 部署练习 NFT 并发给测试账户
milestones.en: Deploy a practice NFT and issue it to test accounts

milestones.zh: 用一次性消息验证钱包签名
milestones.en: Verify wallet signatures with one-use messages

milestones.zh: 服务端读取持有情况并保护内容
milestones.en: Check ownership server-side and protect content

milestones.zh: 测试转让、撤销、过期与重放
milestones.en: Test transfer, revocation, expiry, and replay

milestones.zh: 解释链上与网站各自负责什么
milestones.en: Explain the responsibilities of chain and website

assessment.zh: 仅改浏览器状态不能解锁内容
assessment.en: Changing browser state cannot unlock content

assessment.zh: 转让或撤销后旧持有人失去下一次访问权限
assessment.en: After transfer or revocation, the previous holder loses access on the next check

extension.zh: 社团会员、活动通行证或创作者内容；不涉及投资承诺。
extension.en: Club membership, event passes, or creator content, without investment promises.

entry.zh: 能完成签名登录和服务端授权，理解合约状态。
entry.en: Can implement signed sign-in and server authorization and explain contract state.

outcome.zh: 一个有完整状态流程、异常处理和审计记录的去中心化应用。
outcome.en: A decentralized app with complete state transitions, failure handling, and an audit trail.

milestones.zh: 选定规则：会员治理、凭证或测试收款
milestones.en: Choose rules for membership governance, credentials, or test payments

milestones.zh: 设计合约与链下数据的边界
milestones.en: Design the boundary between contracts and offchain data

milestones.zh: 实现事件读取与状态同步
milestones.en: Read events and synchronize state

milestones.zh: 处理重复、等待、撤销和服务中断
milestones.en: Handle duplicates, pending states, revocation, and outages

milestones.zh: 测试权限攻击与故障恢复
milestones.en: Test permission attacks and recovery

milestones.zh: 整理威胁模型、实验和使用说明
milestones.en: Document the threat model, experiments, and operation

assessment.zh: 重启或重复事件不造成重复发放或重复记账
assessment.en: Restarts and repeated events do not duplicate issuance or accounting

assessment.zh: 能说明中心化依赖、隐私取舍和未解决风险
assessment.en: Explain centralized dependencies, privacy tradeoffs, and remaining risks

extension.zh: 测试网收款、可撤销凭证、会员投票；题目与范围单独确认。
extension.en: Testnet checkout, revocable credentials, or member voting; scope is agreed individually.

description.zh: 把邮件整理成待办，找到需要回复的内容，生成由你确认的回复草稿。
description.en: Turn messages into a useful task list, find what needs a reply, and prepare drafts for you to review.

outcome.zh: 一个可运行的助手、示例邮件、测试记录和自己的使用说明。
outcome.en: A working assistant, sample messages, test notes, and a guide for your own workflow.

milestones.zh: 先选一个最烦的环节
milestones.en: Choose the part you want to fix

milestones.zh: 做出收件箱与待办视图
milestones.en: Build an inbox and a task view

milestones.zh: 加上 AI 分类和草稿
milestones.en: Add AI sorting and drafts

milestones.zh: 用不那么整齐的邮件测试
milestones.en: Try the awkward cases

milestones.zh: 接入自己的工作习惯
milestones.en: Fit it into your routine

milestones.zh: 用一组邮件完整演示
milestones.en: Walk through a complete batch

description.zh: 以招聘平台为起点，完成职位发布、搜索、申请和 AI 信息整理。也可以根据兴趣改成商家接单或社团平台。
description.en: Develop a recruiting platform with job posting, search, applications, and AI-assisted summaries. Adapt the project into an ordering system or club platform if that fits your interests.

outcome.zh: 一个可访问的产品原型、源代码、演示和启动说明。
outcome.en: A working product prototype, source code, a demo, and setup instructions.

outcome.zh: 从招聘平台到 AI 助手，把界面、数据库和业务流程做完整。
outcome.en: Develop complete products—from recruiting platforms to AI assistants—with interfaces, databases, and working workflows.

milestones.zh: 定下第一个版本
milestones.en: Define the first version

milestones.zh: 让内容保存下来
milestones.en: Save the important things

milestones.zh: 打通核心流程
milestones.en: Connect the main journey

milestones.zh: 加一个有用的 AI 功能
milestones.en: Add one useful AI feature

milestones.zh: 让别人来试
milestones.en: Let someone else try it

milestones.zh: 交付你的作品
milestones.en: Present your product

description.zh: 测量温度、湿度或土壤变化，在网页里看到读数，再让灯光或小舵机作出反应。
description.en: Measure temperature, humidity, or soil changes, view the readings on a dashboard, and make an LED or small servo respond.

outcome.zh: 一个低压传感器装置、可视化面板、接线图、实验记录与代码。
outcome.en: A low-voltage sensing device, dashboard, wiring diagram, experiment notes, and code.

outcome.zh: 读取环境数据、控制机械动作，逐步挑战自动照料装置与避障小车。
outcome.en: Connect sensors, code, and motion. Progress toward automated plant care and obstacle-avoiding robots.

milestones.zh: 选择一个要测量的变化
milestones.en: Choose something to measure

milestones.zh: 读到第一个数值
milestones.en: Read the first value

milestones.zh: 让读数值得相信
milestones.en: Check whether readings make sense

milestones.zh: 做一个能看懂的面板
milestones.en: Build a useful dashboard

milestones.zh: 加一个小动作
milestones.en: Add a small response

milestones.zh: 演示一次完整实验
milestones.en: Demonstrate the experiment

description.zh: 输入一笔交易，看到它用了哪些资金、发往哪里、付了多少手续费，以及是否被确认。
description.en: Look up a transaction and see its inputs, outputs, fee, and confirmation status.

outcome.zh: 自己的交易追踪页面，一笔练习交易的分析，以及可重复的测试步骤。
outcome.en: Your own tracker, an annotated practice transaction, and repeatable test steps.

milestones.zh: 准备自己的练习网络
milestones.en: Set up a practice network

milestones.zh: 亲手发出一笔交易
milestones.en: Make a transaction

milestones.zh: 读懂这笔交易
milestones.en: Read the transaction

milestones.zh: 把数据做成页面
milestones.en: Build the tracker view

milestones.zh: 处理等待和错误
milestones.en: Handle waiting and errors

milestones.zh: 解释一笔完整交易
milestones.en: Explain the whole transaction

description.zh: 创建测试订单，连接练习钱包，核对收款，生成收据。把“支付成功”后面发生的事做清楚。
description.en: Create a test order, connect a practice wallet, verify a payment, and issue a receipt.

outcome.zh: 一个测试收款应用、订单记录、可核对的收据及异常情况测试。
outcome.en: A test checkout, order records, verifiable receipts, and failure-case tests.

milestones.zh: 创建一张测试订单
milestones.en: Create a test order

milestones.zh: 准备付款页面
milestones.en: Build the payment screen

milestones.zh: 发出练习付款
milestones.en: Send a practice payment

milestones.zh: 核对链上记录
milestones.en: Verify the on-chain record

milestones.zh: 处理少付、重复与失败
milestones.en: Handle mismatches and retries

milestones.zh: 生成可核对的收据
milestones.en: Produce a verifiable receipt

description.zh: 用钱包证明身份，用链上的 NFT 决定访问权限。亲手做出会员页面，测试转让、到期和撤销后的变化。
description.en: Use wallet signatures to prove account control and an onchain NFT to determine access. Build a members-only page and test transfers, expiry, and revocation.

outcome.zh: 一个会员验证应用、练习 Token、权限测试和明确的会员规则。
outcome.en: A membership app, practice tokens, access tests, and explicit membership rules.

outcome.zh: 做 NFT 会员系统，用智能合约、钱包签名和持有验证管理访问权限。
outcome.en: Develop NFT membership systems using smart contracts, wallet signatures, and ownership checks to control access.

milestones.zh: 先写会员规则
milestones.en: Define the membership rules

milestones.zh: 发行练习通行证
milestones.en: Issue practice passes

milestones.zh: 证明账户由你控制
milestones.en: Prove control of the account

milestones.zh: 接上会员页面
milestones.en: Connect the members’ page

milestones.zh: 检查权益变化
milestones.en: Test changes in access

milestones.zh: 解释你的会员系统
milestones.en: Explain your membership system
